content.short: WatchPug provides smart contract security audits focused on security.
content.description: WatchPug is a security-focused team dedicated to strengthening the DeFi ecosystem by improving the security, privacy, and usability of smart contracts. They perform thorough assessments of contracts to identify vulnerabilities, design weaknesses, and potential privacy implications, helping developers build more secure and reliable protocols. In addition to comprehensive in-depth smart contract security audits, WatchPug offers rapid 1-day security reviews to provide timely risk assessment and actionable remediation guidance for projects under tight deadlines.
